definitions: To make your own decisions and follow your own ambitions, rather than conforming to others' expectations or following a predetermined course.
To create a unique direction for your life or career, independent of traditional routes or external influences.
examples: She decided to leave her corporate job and chart her own path as an entrepreneur.
It takes courage to chart your own path, especially when it's different from what everyone else is doing.
He always encouraged his children to chart their own path and pursue their passions.
